label: Multi-platform writer
intro: I write and strategize for experiences on every medium (and lately, I lead). Today that’s the UX Writer Hub at Telkom Indonesia.
description: UX writer and content designer in Jakarta. I lead the UX Writer Hub at Telkom Indonesia and design conversations for AI, after ten years of ads and scripts.
about:
I was born when David Bowie and Mick Jagger’s “Dancing in the Street” topped the UK chart, and I gave up drawing after a year of kindergarten. Words stuck.
I wrote ads, TV scripts and the odd song before I took the leap to UX writing. Whoever I write for, I try to see through their eyes (yes, even a toddler’s).

contactText: Write to me about a project, a collaboration or a talk (or ask where to find the best fried rice in Jakarta).
